milestone: M0 Contact-Conditioned Multi-Behavior LPP minimal loop

track_A.first: One fixed alpha=.5 up30 probe, same original BFM/PD/Tether and previous partner; reuse original standing/full-alpha records
track_A.after: Only if controllable, at most3 additional bounded teacher-qualification episodes with a separately frozen causal progress rule. Otherwise stop this native path; audit existing task-expert assets without downloads/new WBC.

track_B.expert: Existing unchanged bounded Jacobian right-arm correction .04rad per joint/.08rad norm,10Hz plus original .2s50Hz ReleaseFade, on standing frozen BFM. BFM-assisted independent local feedback target, not a fully independent WBC.
track_B.student: Original 474->128->128->256 MLP and deploy_input;10Hz raw projected to norm16 with original .3 standing tangent bound and ContactGate,50Hz actor/PD; no privileged anchor/time/direction inputs
track_B.data: Old actual expert + new dev actual expert + actual P0 visited dev states relabeled with same expert + no-contact P0 states; equal group minibatches, no heldout labels/data

representability.gate: Exact original per-frame ContactGate,5 observations per10Hz decision
representability.meaning: Feasibility/latent-label construction only, not itself LPP

fit.initialization: Same frozen old single-scene P0 for both methods, normalization frozen
fit.alignment: Teacher actual29D q_PD rightarm MSE +.1 nonarm MSE +1e-6 tanh(raw)^2, active5/release2/pre1
fit.direct_latent: Match constrained temporary teacher-projected z at same5 frame gates; no BFM action loss
fit.checkpoint: Final step1000 only, no tuning/test selection

evaluation.rule: Fixed mean projected active tangent from dev/oldexpert labels, original causal contact gate; no learned state conditioning

track_B.qualification: Real unseen full-contact XYZ error improves>=10% vs standing; force not worse>5%; no fall/support loss/limits,2s recovery<=.02m/s. Report learning/aggregation effects and all baseline failures separately.

track_C.gate: Two independently useful behaviorally qualified and frozen-BFM representable skills; forward/local alone do not automatically establish a needed second behavior. If unavailable, do not train a selector or multi-behavior policy.
track_C.budget: Only within remaining global time/memory; baseline/heldout protocol frozen before any conditional training.

stops: Unsafe physical control, identity mismatch, resource exceed, essential expert asset missing, or unrepresentable/unidentifiable target ends affected track. Finish independent authorized work. No shared edits, new WBC/PD, PPO, large downloads, latent/reward search or push.
